SHASHIKANT JAMNADAS THAKKAR - (VENDOR) PANCHVATI  RESTAURANT....Opponent(s)/Respondent(s)
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
MR LB DABHI APP for the Appellant(s) No. 1  RULE SERVED for the Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) No. 1  UNSERVED-EXPIRED (R) for the Opponent(s)/Respondent(s) No. 1

=
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE K.M.THAKER  Date : 15/09/2015

ORAL ORDER 1. Heard Mr. Dabhi, learned APP for the appellant.
2. This Appeal under Section 377 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is filed by the appellant State against the judgment and order dated 8.12.2009 passed in Criminal Case No. 553 of 1996 by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Himmatnagar for enhancement of the sentence qua HC-NIC Page 1 of 4 Created On Sat Sep 19 00:28:40 IST 2015 R/CR.A/312/2010 ORDER original accused No.1.
3.

The said appeal is preferred by the State against the judgment and order dated 8.12.2009 passed by the learned trial Court under Sections 7(1) and 7(5) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954.
The learned trial Court sentenced the accused to pay fine of Rs.2,000/- and in default, to undergo SI for 5 days.
The State has preferred the appeal seeking enhancement in the sentence.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 4 . The appeal came to be admitted vide order dated 27.7.2010.
The sole respondent i.e. original accused No.1 in the appeal died on 10.7.2015 i.e. during the pendency of the appeal.
5. This appeal is admitted vide order dated 27.7.2010.

6. Learned APP submitted that the concerned officer has supplied him a copy of the statement made by the son of the sole respondent (since HC-NIC Page 2 of 4 Created On Sat Sep 19 00:28:40 IST 2015 R/CR.A/312/2010 ORDER deceased).
The learned APP also submitted that a photocopy of the death certificate is also supplied to him by the concerned officer.

In light of the said statement and information supplied to him by the concerned officer viz. that the said sole respondent has died on 10.7.2015 and on verification of said fact learned APP submitted that since the sole respondent has died during pendency of the Appeal filed under Section 377 of the Code the appeal now stands abated in view of section 394 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the said Criminal Appeal No.312 of 2010 may be disposed of accordingly.
7. In light of the submissions by learned APP, this appeal, which is filed under section 377 wherein there is the sole respondent, abates in view of the provision under Section 394 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
This appeal, therefore, accordingly stands disposed of as abated.
The Death Certificate of the respondent HC-NIC Page 3 of 4 Created On Sat Sep 19 00:28:40 IST 2015 R/CR.A/312/2010 ORDER is taken on record.
Orders accordingly.
